entities.text: Rabindra Hazra vs State Of West Benga And Anr
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
2023 
In The High Court At Calcutta 14-08-2023 Criminal Revisional Jurisdiction Subha Item no.
12 Crr 2912 of 2023 Ct no.34 Rabindra Hazra
-versus-
State of West Benga and Anr.
Mr. Rameswar Sinha Ms. Priyanka Bhowmik ....for the petitioner.
Mr. S. G. Mukherji, ld. Pp Mr. Imran Ali Mrs. Debjani Sahu ....for the State.
Petitioner is directed to serve a copy of the revisional application upon Mr. Imran Ali, learned advocate who ordinarily appears on behalf of the State.
His appointment may be regularized by the concerned authorities in due course.

Petitioner is also directed to serve copy of the revisional application upon the opposite party no. 2 by speed post with acknowledgement due and file affidavit of service on the next date fixed for hearing.
The subject matter of the revisional application relates to the issue relating to 2nd FIR.
Learned advocate has drawn the attention of the court to both the FIRs, being Muchipara P. S. Case no. 188 of 2018 dated 17.06.2018 and Egra P. S. Case No. 742 of 2022 dated 16.10.2022.

entities.text: Muchipara P. S. Case no. 188 of 2018
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

entities.text: Egra P. S. Case No. 742 of 2022
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: Both the cases were registered for alleged offences under Sections 498A of the Indian Penal Code and other allied sections of similar nature.
Having regard to the same I am of the opinion that the revisional application is required to be heard out on merits.
Accordingly, let the revisional application appear under the heading "Contested Application" in the combined monthly list of December, 2023.
Learned advocate for the State would produce case diary of both the cases on the date so fixed.

There shall be a stay of the further proceedings of Egra P. S. Case No. 742 of 2022 dated 16.10.2022 pending before the learned Judicial Magistrate, 2nd court, Contai, Purba Medinipur till 22nd December, 2023.

[Tirthankar Ghosh, J]
